newsitem.title: GERMANY: New Ukraine investment council to meet end of July.
newsitem.headline: New Ukraine investment council to meet end of July.

text.p: A Ukrainian foreign investment council which will settle business disputes and advise President Leonid Kuchma will meet for the first time in July, Ukraine's development agency chief said on Tuesday.

"The Chamber of Independent Experts will work to create good conditions for foreign investors in Ukraine," Roman Shpek, head of the National Agency for Reconstruction and Development told an investment conference in Frankfurt.
"It will have its first meeting at the end of the month," Shpek told a conference, adding that the chamber would be staffed by Ukrainian and foreign legal experts.
The chamber would play an ombudsman's role to help businesses encountering investment roadblocks to avoid costly and lengthy court disputes, he said.

Ukraine, which has attracted only $1.5 billion in foreign investment since independence in 1991, has been criticised for an unwelcome investment climate characterised by unwieldy laws, punitive taxes and corruption.
